faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our play space and booking.

items.question: What are the table booking rates?
items.answer: Booking a standard table starts at €2 per hour per player, or is free when buying snacks/drinks or boosters at the counter.

items.question: Do I need to bring my own cards?
items.answer: Yes, for free play and constructed tournaments, you must bring your decks. However, we sell boosters, starter decks, and we sometimes lend demo decks.

items.question: How do I register for a TCG or board game tournament?
items.answer: You can register directly online from the 'Tournaments' page or on-site at the counter up to 15 minutes before the event begins.

items.question: Can I bring my own food and drinks?
items.answer: We offer a cafe area with cold/hot drinks and snacks. To preserve tables and other players' cards, outside food and drinks are not allowed.
